cases.name: Add a task and keep it after reload
steps: Add a todo called Buy milk.
Verify that Buy milk appears as an unchecked task.
Verify that Buy milk is still present and unchecked.

cases.name: Complete a todo and filter the list
steps: Add a todo called Book dentist.
Check the checkbox next to Book dentist.
Verify that its checkbox is checked and the remaining count is zero.
Switch Show tasks to Active and verify that no tasks are listed.
Switch Show tasks to Completed and verify that Book dentist is shown.

cases.name: Reject an empty task
steps: Try adding a todo containing only spaces.
Verify the message Enter a task. is shown.
Verify that no tasks were created.
